about: CI cost manifest (ci-spend law, 2026-10-11). One entry per workflow, one leg per runner OS. scripts/check_workflow_runner_cost.py fails a workflow or OS leg without an entry, an entry without a benefit, triggers/crons/jobs that differ from the workflow file, $ that do not add up, a repo total over repo_share_usd, and (locally, with sibling repos beside it) a sum over the weekly ceiling.
prices_source: GitHub billing API pricePerUnit (Actions Linux / Windows / macOS 3-core), read 2026-10-11

ci.yml.benefit: Full extension build/lint/tests and development artifact for runtime changes; fast tracked-document validation for docs-only pushes and PRs, freeing the main CI queue without claiming a new artifact.
ci.yml.owner_reason: Before it, nothing was enforced on PRs (AUDIT P0-8).
ci.yml.basis: Conservative upper bound from observed 2026-10-02..09: ~2500 runs/week; sampled Linux 3.2 min and macOS 1.5 min. The docs-only path adds a short Linux classification/validation job but skips Linux full checks and macOS integration for eligible runs. At a hypothetical 10% eligible share, projected variable runner use falls by about $28/week at list price, before the small classifier cost; actual public-repo billed increment is $0. The manifest retains the higher all-full-run forecast until the eligible share and classifier duration are measured. Conservative all-full-run ceiling includes 0.5 Linux minute per run for the new classifier, artifact-provenance API read, and validation lane; no additional macOS time.

focused-acceptance.yml.benefit: Newest relevant main commit's focused acceptance, outside the CI queue.
focused-acceptance.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): 466/week x 1 min

hosted-guest-acceptance.yml.benefit: Native side-panel acceptance on a hosted Mac guest, including EXT-D-0217 retained-profile Save/Retry, EXT-D-0221 admin Screenshots T04/T05, and a focused EXT-D-0262 Settings guest admin-absence check on the existing guarded lane; no extra job or schedule.
hosted-guest-acceptance.yml.owner_reason: Extension acceptance on a real browser.
hosted-guest-acceptance.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09: 288 dispatches/week x 4.8 macOS min plus one on-demand D221 Screenshots run/week. The focused D262 guest Settings check replaces a broader Settings rerun within the existing 289 on-demand runs/week. The readiness window permits two additional 15-second intervals at each of three stages; budget 1.75 extra minutes per run, including observed ~1-second/sample overhead, for all 289 runs. Public runner billed $0.

hosted-resource-diagnostic.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): 1/week x 2 macOS min

release.yml.benefit: Hosted release: publishes main and the immutable v* tag with the Store ZIP.
release.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): 13/week x 5 min
